docs.title: VQL (Valthera Query Language)
docs.text: VQL is a comprehensive framework for interacting with ValtheraDB. It provides dual query syntaxes, advanced relation handling, and an integrated permission system.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Dual Query Syntax: VQLR (JSON-based, programmatic) and VQLS (string-based, CLI-friendly)
  • Multi-Database Support: Query across multiple ValtheraDB instances
  • Cross-Platform: Node.js and browser compatible
  • Dynamic Variables: Predefined (_me, _user, _now) and custom variables
  • Advanced Relations: Native cross-database relationship queries
  • Permission System: Optional, granular access control via Gate Warden
  • Falcon Frame Integration: HTTP API exposure

docs.title: Quick Example
docs.text:
import VQLProcessor from "@wxn0brp/vql";
import { Valthera } from "@wxn0brp/db";

const db = new Valthera("./data/my-db");
const processor = new VQLProcessor({ main: db });

// VQLS
const result1 = await processor.execute(`main users s.status="active" e.name=1`);

// VQLR
const result2 = await processor.execute({
  db: "main",
  d: { find: { collection: "users", search: { status: "active" }, select: ["name"] } }
});

// With variables
const result3 = await processor.execute({
  query: `main ~users! s.role=$role u.lastLogin=$_now`,
  var: { role: "admin" }
}, userContext);

docs.title: VQLProcessor
docs.text:
import VQLProcessor, { VQLConfig } from "@wxn0brp/vql";

const processor = new VQLProcessor(
  dbInstances,  // Record<string, ValtheraCompatible>
  config,       // VQLConfig (optional)
  permValidFn   // Permission function (optional)
);

const result = await processor.execute(query, user);

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
const config = new VQLConfig({
  noCheckPermissions: true,   // Default: true (permissions disabled)
  strictSelect: false,        // Empty select = no filtering (true = no fields)
  strictACL: false,           // Fallback to parent path on 404
  hidePath: false,            // Show actual paths in errors
  permissionDeniedIfNoUser: true  // Deny if no user context
});

docs.title: Query Lifecycle
docs.text:
1. Parse query (VQLS → VQLR or pass-through)
  2. Validate raw structure (r or db+d keys)
  3. Resolve variables ($var, {__: "var"})
  4. Validate VQL query (detailed structure check)
  5. Check permissions (if enabled)
  6. Execute against ValtheraDB
  7. Return result

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Node.js (or Bun)
  • ValtheraDB installed
npm install @wxn0brp/db @wxn0brp/vql

docs.title: Step 1: Initialize
docs.text:
import VQLProcessor from "@wxn0brp/vql";
import { Valthera } from "@wxn0brp/db";

const userDb = new Valthera("./data/users-db");
const productDb = new Valthera("./data/products-db");

// Add sample data
await userDb.add("users", { _id: "user1", name: "Alice", age: 30 });
await userDb.add("users", { _id: "user2", name: "Bob", age: 25 });
await productDb.add("items", { _id: "item1", name: "Laptop", price: 1200 });

const dbInstances = { users: userDb, products: productDb };
const processor = new VQLProcessor(dbInstances);

docs.title: Step 2: VQLR Query (Object Syntax)
docs.text:
import type { VQLUQ } from "@wxn0brp/vql";

const query: VQLUQ = {
  db: "users",
  d: {
    find: {
      collection: "users",
      search: { $gt: { age: 20 } },
      select: { name: 1, age: 1 }
    }
  }
};

const result = await processor.execute(query);
// [{ name: "Alice", age: 30 }, { name: "Bob", age: 25 }]

docs.title: Step 3: VQLS Query (String Syntax)
docs.text:
const query: VQLUQ = `products items s.$gt.price=100 e.name=1 e.price=1`;
const result = await processor.execute(query);
// [{ name: "Laptop", price: 1200 }]

docs.title: Step 4: Variables
docs.text:
// Predefined variables
await processor.execute(`users +users d.name="Charlie" d.createdAt=$_now`);

// Custom variables
const result = await processor.execute({
  query: `users users s.age>$minAge e.name=1`,
  var: { minAge: 25 }
});

docs.title: Step 5: Update Data
docs.text:
// VQLS updateOne
await processor.execute(`products ~items! s.name="Laptop" u.price=1100`);

// Verify
const item = await processor.execute(`products items s.name="Laptop"`);

docs.title: Step 6: Collection Management
docs.text:
await processor.execute(`users ensureCollection logs`);
const collections = await processor.execute(`users getCollections`);
await processor.execute(`users removeCollection logs`);

docs.title: Step 7: Enable Permissions (Optional)
docs.text:
import { VQLConfig } from "@wxn0brp/vql";
import { PermissionResolverEngine } from "@wxn0brp/vql/permissions/resolver";

const engine = new PermissionResolverEngine();
engine.addResolver("password", async () => false, "endsWith");
const permValidFn = engine.create();

const secureProcessor = new VQLProcessor(
  dbInstances,
  new VQLConfig({ noCheckPermissions: false }),
  permValidFn
);

const user = { _id: "user123", role: "admin" };
const result = await secureProcessor.execute(query, user);

docs.text:

  • HTTP Integration - Expose via API

docs.title: HTTP API Integration
docs.text: Expose your VQLProcessor as an HTTP endpoint using Falcon Frame.

docs.title: Server-Side: FF_VQL
docs.text:
import { FalconFrame } from "@wxn0brp/falcon-frame";
import { VQLProcessor, FF_VQL } from "@wxn0brp/vql";
import { Valthera } from "@wxn0brp/db";

const db = new Valthera("./data/my-db");
const processor = new VQLProcessor({ main: db });

const app = new FalconFrame();

FF_VQL(app, processor);

app.l(3000);

docs.title: Options
docs.text:
interface FF_VQL_Options {
  path?: string;         // Route path (default: "/VQL")
  getUser?: ContextFn;   // Extract user context from request
  getQuery?: GetQueryFn; // Custom query extraction
}

docs.title: User Context
docs.text:
FF_VQL(app, processor, {
  getUser: async (req, res) => {
    const token = req.header("Authorization")?.replace("Bearer ", "");
    const data = jwt.decode(token);
    if (data) {
      const dbUser = await db.findOne("users", { _id: data._id });
      return dbUser;
    }
    return { _id: "guest", role: "guest" };
  }
});

The returned object is passed to processor.execute() and available in permission resolvers.

docs.title: Custom Query Extraction
docs.text:
FF_VQL(app, processor, {
  getQuery: async (req, res) => {
    const query = req.query.get("q");
    return query ? JSON.parse(query) : req.body.query;
  }
});

docs.title: createVqlRouteHandler
docs.text:
For more control over routing:

import { createVqlRouteHandler } from "@wxn0brp/vql/helpers/falconFrame";

const handler = createVqlRouteHandler(processor, {
  getUser: async (req) => ({ _id: "user123" })
});

app.post("/custom-vql", handler);

docs.title: Response Format
docs.text:
Success: 

{ "err": false, "result": { /* data */ } }

Error: 

{ "err": true, "msg": "Error message", "c": 400 }

docs.title: Frontend: VQL Client
docs.text:
Use @wxn0brp/vql-client to communicate with the endpoint.

npm install @wxn0brp/vql-client

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
import { VConfig } from "@wxn0brp/vql-client";

VConfig.url = "http://localhost:3000/VQL";
VConfig.headers = { "Authorization": "Bearer TOKEN" };
VConfig.body = {};  // Default body fields
VConfig.hookContext = {};  // Default hook context

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
import { fetchVQL, V } from "@wxn0brp/vql-client";

// VQLS with variables
const users = await fetchVQL(
  "mainDB users s.status=$status",
  { status: "active" }
);

// Tagged template literal
const item = await V`mainDB items! s._id="item-001"`;

// VQLR object
const result = await fetchVQL({
  db: "mainDB",
  d: { find: { collection: "users", search: { role: "admin" } } }
});

// With hook context and fetch options
const data = await fetchVQL(
  "mainDB users s.role=$role",
  { role: "admin" },  // vars
  { requestId: "123" },  // hookContext
  { signal: abortController.signal }  // fetchOptions
);

docs.title: Hooks
docs.text:
VConfig.hooks = {
  onStart: (query, hookContext) => {
    console.log("Starting:", query);
  },
  onEnd: (query, durationMs, result, hookContext) => {
    console.log(`Completed in ${durationMs}ms:`, result);
  },
  onError: (query, error, result, hookContext) => {
    console.error("Failed:", error);
  }
};

docs.title: Custom Transport
docs.text:
import { VConfig } from "@wxn0brp/vql-client";

VConfig.transport = async (query, fetchOptions) => {
  // Custom transport logic
  const res = await fetch("/custom-endpoint", {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify({ query }),
    ...fetchOptions
  });
  return res.json();
};

docs.title: Browser/CDN Usage
docs.text:
When loaded via script tag, the client is available as window.VQLClient:

VQLClient.cfg.url = "/api/vql";
const result = await VQLClient.fetchVQL("db users");
const item = await VQLClient.V`db items! s._id="123"`;

docs.title: Permissions
docs.text: VQL has an optional programmatic permission system. Disabled by default.

docs.title: Enabling Permissions
docs.text:
import VQLProcessor, { VQLConfig } from "@wxn0brp/vql";

const processor = new VQLProcessor(
  dbInstances,
  new VQLConfig({
    noCheckPermissions: false,
    strictSelect: true,   // REQUIRED when permissions are enabled
    strictACL: true,
  }),
  permValidFn
);

docs.title: Permission Validation Function
docs.text:
type PermValidFn = (args: PermValidFnArgs) => Promise<ValidFnResult>;

interface PermValidFnArgs {
  field: string;    // Path (hashed if hidePath: true)
  path: string[];   // Original path segments
  p: number;        // CRUD bitmask
  user: any;        // User context from execute()
}

interface ValidFnResult {
  granted: boolean;
  via?: "resolver" | "gate-warden";
  reason?: string;
}

docs.title: CRUD Levels
docs.text:
import { PermCRUD } from "@wxn0brp/vql/types/perm";

enum PermCRUD {
  CREATE = 1,
  READ = 2,
  UPDATE = 4,
  DELETE = 8,
  COLLECTION = 16
}

docs.title: PermissionResolverEngine
docs.text:
Helper for building permValidFn with path-based resolvers.

import { PermissionResolverEngine } from "@wxn0brp/vql/permissions/resolver";

const engine = new PermissionResolverEngine();

// Block passwords
engine.addResolver("password", async () => false, "endsWith");

// Allow admins
engine.addResolver("users", async (args) => args.user?.role === "admin", "startsWith");

const permValidFn = engine.create();

docs.title: Matchers
docs.text: Type Example Description string "users/email" Path matching (configurable mode) RegExp /password$/ Pattern matching function (path, segments) => boolean Custom logic

docs.title: String Matcher Modes
docs.text:
engine.addResolver("password", resolver, "endsWith");    // users/password
engine.addResolver("users/", resolver, "startsWith");    // users/email
engine.addResolver("secret", resolver, "includes");      // config/secret_key
engine.addResolver("users/email", resolver);             // exact (default)

docs.title: Resolver Function
docs.text:
engine.addResolver("users/email", async (args) => {
  if (args.user?.role === "admin") return true;
  if (args.user?._id === args.path[1]) return true;  // own record
  if (args.p & PermCRUD.READ) return true;
  return false;
});

docs.title: Creating Permission Function
docs.text:
// Custom resolvers only (unmatched = denied)
const permValidFn = engine.create();

// Fall back to Gate Warden if no match
import { GateWarden } from "@wxn0brp/gate-warden";
const gw = new GateWarden();
const permValidFn = engine.createWithGw(gw);

docs.title: createGwValidFn
docs.text:
Simpler Gate Warden integration without custom resolvers:

import { createGwValidFn } from "@wxn0brp/vql";
import { GateWarden } from "@wxn0brp/gate-warden";

const gw = new GateWarden();
const permValidFn = createGwValidFn(gw);

docs.title: Complete Example
docs.text:
import VQLProcessor, { VQLConfig } from "@wxn0brp/vql";
import { PermissionResolverEngine } from "@wxn0brp/vql/permissions/resolver";
import { GateWarden } from "@wxn0brp/gate-warden";

const gw = new GateWarden();
gw.addRole("admin", ["users.*", "posts.*"]);
gw.addRole("user", ["posts.read"]);

const engine = new PermissionResolverEngine();
engine.addResolver("password", async () => false, "endsWith");
engine.addResolver("", async (args) => args.user?.role === "admin");

const permValidFn = engine.createWithGw(gw);

const processor = new VQLProcessor(
  dbInstances,
  new VQLConfig({ noCheckPermissions: false, strictSelect: true }),
  permValidFn
);

const result = await processor.execute(query, { _id: "user123", role: "user" });

docs.title: VQLR (Runtime)
docs.text: JSON-based object syntax for VQL. The internal AST format, ideal for programmatic use and TypeScript.

docs.title: Structure
docs.text:
interface VQL_Query {
  db?: string;           // Target database instance
  d?: VQL_Query_CRUD;    // CRUD operation
  r?: VQL_Query_Relation; // Relational query
  var?: Record<string, any>; // Variables
}

docs.title: find
docs.text:
interface VQL_OP_Find {
  collection: string;
  search?: Search;
  limit?: number;
  select?: VQL_Fields;
  options?: DbFindOpts;
  searchOpts?: FindOpts;
}

{ db: "main", d: { find: { collection: "users", search: { status: "active" }, limit: 10, select: { name: 1 } } } }

docs.title: findOne / f
docs.text:
interface VQL_OP_FindOne {
  collection: string;
  search: Search;
  select?: VQL_Fields;
  searchOpts?: FindOpts;
}

{ db: "main", d: { findOne: { collection: "users", search: { _id: "123" } } } }
{ db: "main", d: { f: { collection: "users", search: { _id: "123" } } } }  // alias

docs.title: add
docs.text:
interface VQL_OP_Add {
  collection: string;
  data: Arg;
  id_gen?: boolean;  // default: true
}

{ db: "main", d: { add: { collection: "users", data: { name: "Alice", age: 30 } } } }

docs.title: update / updateOne
docs.text:
interface VQL_OP_Update {
  collection: string;
  search: Search;
  updater: UpdaterArg;
  select?: VQL_Fields;  // Filter returned fields
}

{ db: "main", d: { update: { collection: "users", search: { role: "guest" }, updater: { role: "user" }, select: ["name"] } } }
{ db: "main", d: { updateOne: { collection: "users", search: { _id: "123" }, updater: { name: "Bob" } } } }

docs.title: remove / removeOne
docs.text:
interface VQL_OP_Remove {
  collection: string;
  search: Search;
  select?: VQL_Fields;  // Filter returned fields
}

{ db: "main", d: { remove: { collection: "users", search: { active: false } } } }
{ db: "main", d: { removeOne: { collection: "users", search: { _id: "123" }, select: { name: 1 } } } }

docs.title: updateOneOrAdd
docs.text:
interface VQL_OP_UpdateOneOrAdd {
  collection: string;
  search: Search;
  updater: UpdaterArg;
  add_arg?: Arg;
  id_gen?: boolean;
  select?: VQL_Fields;  // Filter returned fields
}

{ db: "main", d: { updateOneOrAdd: { collection: "users", search: { _id: "123" }, updater: { name: "Bob" }, add_arg: { name: "Bob", email: "b@x.com" } } } }

docs.title: toggleOne
docs.text:
interface VQL_OP_ToggleOne {
  collection: string;
  search: Search;
  data?: Arg;
  select?: VQL_Fields;  // Filter returned fields
}

{ db: "main", d: { toggleOne: { collection: "favorites", search: { userId: "123", itemId: "456" }, select: ["_id"] } } }

docs.title: Collection Management
docs.text:
{ db: "main", d: { ensureCollection: { collection: "logs" } } }
{ db: "main", d: { issetCollection: { collection: "logs" } } }
{ db: "main", d: { removeCollection: { collection: "temp" } } }
{ db: "main", d: { getCollections: {} } }

docs.title: Relational Queries (r key)
docs.text:
interface VQL_Query_Relation {
  r: {
    path: [string, string];           // [db, collection]
    search?: Search;
    relations?: Record<string, {
      path: [string, string];
      search?: Search;
      select?: string[];
    }>;
    many?: boolean;                   // true = find, false = findOne
    options?: DbFindOpts;
    select?: string[] | Record<string, any>;
  };
}

{
  r: {
    path: ["main", "orders"],
    search: { status: "pending" },
    many: true,
    relations: {
      customer: { path: ["main", "users"], select: ["name", "email"] },
      items: { path: ["inventory", "products"] }
    }
  }
}

docs.title: Field Selection
docs.text:
// Record format
select: { name: 1, email: 1 }

// Array format
select: ["name", "email"]

docs.title: Variables
docs.text:
Use { __: "variableName" } for references. See Language Overview.

{
  db: "main",
  d: { add: { collection: "users", data: { ownerId: { __: "_me" }, createdAt: { __: "_now" } } } },
  var: { customVar: "value" }
}

docs.title: TypeScript Types
docs.text:
import type {
  VQL_Query, VQL_Query_CRUD, VQL_Query_Relation,
  VQL_OP_Find, VQL_OP_FindOne, VQL_OP_Add,
  VQL_OP_Update, VQL_OP_Remove, VQL_OP_UpdateOneOrAdd,
  VQL_OP_ToggleOne, VQL_Fields, VQL_Var
} from "@wxn0brp/vql";

docs.title: Find with all options
docs.text:
{
  db: "main",
  d: {
    find: {
      collection: "users",
      search: { status: "active", $gt: { age: 18 }, $lte: { age: 65 } },
      select: { name: 1, email: 1 },
      limit: 50,
      options: { sort: { age: -1 } },
      searchOpts: { skip: 10 }
    }
  }
}

docs.title: Update with operators
docs.text:
{
  db: "main",
  d: {
    updateOne: {
      collection: "users",
      search: { _id: "123" },
      updater: {
        name: "Bob",
        $inc: { loginCount: 1 },
        $set: { "profile.lastLogin": { __: "_now" } }
      }
    }
  }
}

docs.title: Multi-database relations
docs.text:
{
  r: {
    path: ["orders_db", "orders"],
    search: { status: "shipped" },
    many: true,
    relations: {
      customer: { path: ["users_db", "users"], select: ["name", "email"] },
      items: { path: ["inventory_db", "products"] }
    }
  }
}

docs.title: VQLS (Simple)
docs.text: Human-readable, CLI-friendly string syntax for VQL queries.

docs.title: Syntax
docs.text:
<db> <operation> <collection> [body...]

Or shorthand: 

<db> <collection_with_operator> [body...]

docs.title: Shorthand Operators
docs.text: Prefix/Suffix Operation Example (none) find db users ! findOne db users! + add db +users ~ update db ~users ~! updateOne db ~users! - remove db -users -! removeOne db -users! ? updateOneOrAdd db ?users ^ toggleOne db ^users

docs.title: Explicit Operations
docs.text:
db find users s.status="active"
db findOne users s._id="123"
db add users d.name="Alice"
db update users s.role="guest" u.role="user"
db updateOne users s._id="123" u.name="Bob"
db remove users s.active=false
db removeOne users s._id="123"
db updateOneOrAdd users s._id="123" u.name="Bob"
db toggleOne users s._id="123"
db ensureCollection logs
db issetCollection logs
db removeCollection temp_data
db getCollections

docs.title: Body Prefixes
docs.text: Prefix Purpose Example s. Search conditions s.status="active" d. Data payload (add) d.name="Alice" u. Update payload u.name="Bob" o. Options o.limit=10 r. Relations r.orders.path=["db", "orders"] e. Field selection e.name=1 e.email=1

docs.title: Comparison Operators
docs.text: Operator Meaning Example = Equal s.age=25 > Greater than s.age>18 >= Greater or equal s.age>=18 < Less than s.price<100 <= Less or equal s.price<=100

docs.title: Value Types
docs.text: Type Syntax Example String "value" or 'value' s.name="Alice" Number Numeric s.age=25 Boolean true / false s.active=true Empty = true Empty value s.active= JSON {...} or [...] s.tags=["a","b"]

docs.title: Nested Properties
docs.text:
db users s.address.city="NYC"
db users s.profile.age>18

docs.title: Comments
docs.text:
Lines starting with # or // are ignored: 

# This is a comment
db users s.status="active"
// Another comment

docs.title: Variables
docs.text:
See Language Overview for details.

# Custom variable
db users s.role=$role

# Predefined variables
db users d.createdAt=$_now
db users s.ownerId=$_me

docs.title: Examples
docs.text:
# Find with filters and field selection
db users s.status="active" s.age>18 e.name=1 e.email=1 o.limit=10

# Add record
db +users d.name="Alice" d.email="alice@example.com" d.age=30

# Update single record with field selection (return only specified fields)
db ~users! s._id="123" u.name="Bob" u.updatedAt=$_now e.name=1 e.updatedAt=1

# Update multiple records with field selection
db ~users s.role="guest" u.role="user" e._id=1 e.name=1

# Upsert with field selection
db ?users s._id="123" u.name="Bob" u.lastSeen=$_now e.name=1

# Delete with field selection (return deleted records with only specified fields)
db -users s.active=false e._id=1 e.name=1
db -users! s._id="123" e.name=1

# Toggle with field selection
db ^users s._id="123" e._id=1

# Relations
db users r.orders.path=["db", "orders"] r.orders.search.status="pending"

# Collection management
db ensureCollection logs
db getCollections

docs.title: Multi-line Queries
docs.text:
const query = `
  db users
  s.status="active"
  s.age>18
  e.name=1
  e.email=1
`;

docs.title: Language Overview
docs.text: VQL provides two interchangeable query syntaxes that compile to the same internal representation.

docs.title: Syntaxes
docs.text: Syntax Format Best For VQLS String CLI, configs, quick scripts VQLR Object Programmatic use, TypeScript

docs.title: Operations
docs.text: Operation VQLS VQLR Key Description find db collection find Find multiple records findOne db collection! findOne / f Find single record add db +collection add Insert record update db ~collection update Update matching updateOne db ~collection! updateOne Update single remove db -collection remove Delete matching removeOne db -collection! removeOne Delete single updateOneOrAdd db ?collection updateOneOrAdd Upsert toggleOne db ^collection toggleOne Add/remove toggle ensureCollection db ensureCollection name ensureCollection Create if not exists issetCollection db issetCollection name issetCollection Check exists removeCollection db removeCollection name removeCollection Delete collection getCollections db getCollections getCollections List collections

docs.title: Body Prefixes
docs.text: Prefix Purpose VQLR Key s. Search/filter search d. Data (for add) data u. Update payload updater o. Options (limit) options r. Relations relations e. Field selection select

docs.title: Comparison Operators (VQLS)
docs.text: Operator Meaning Example = Equal s.age=25 > Greater than s.age>18 >= Greater or equal s.age>=18 < Less than s.price<100 <= Less or equal s.price<=100

docs.title: Variables
docs.text: Inject dynamic values into queries.

docs.title: Predefined
docs.text: Variable Value _me user.id \|\| user._id \|\| user _user Full user object _now Date.now() (ms) _nowShort Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) (s) __now Date.now().toString() __nowShort Seconds as string

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
VQLS - $variableName in values: 

db users s.role=$role d.createdAt=$_now

VQLR - { __: "variableName" } for references: 

{ data: { ownerId: { __: "_me" }, createdAt: { __: "_now" } } }

Pass custom variables: 

// VQLS with vars
await processor.execute({ query: `users s.role=$role`, var: { role: "admin" } });

// VQLR with vars
await processor.execute({ db: "main", d: { find: {...} }, var: { custom: "val" } });

docs.title: TypeScript Types
docs.text:
import type { VQLUQ, VQL_Query, VQL_Query_CRUD } from "@wxn0brp/vql";

const q1: VQLUQ = `users s.status="active"`;
const q2: VQLUQ = { db: "main", d: { find: { collection: "users" } } };
